title: Falcon Skydiving
specs: About 50 seconds of freefall per tandem jump
Ceremonies conducted at 14,000 ft with scenic views
Must be at least 18 years old
Weight limit 220 lbs, height and weight proportional
Valid photo ID required (driver's license or state ID)
No impairment from alcohol or drugs allowed
Must join USPA by third AFF jump
Groups generally jump together if possible, usually at least 4 members
Special events like proposals and weddings available

blurb: Guests make tandem skydives harnessed to a Falcon tandem instructor, experiencing about 50 seconds of freefall before parachute deployment and guided landing. Video and photo packages are available to capture the experience. The AFF program offers accelerated free fall training with multiple levels to become a licensed skydiver.
extraNote: Non refundable deposit required for tandem skydive · Weather can cause delays or cancellations; safety is priority · No GoPro cameras allowed on jump · 10 minutes from Kansas Speedway, 15 minutes from downtown Kansas City
